sourceFile: 37. BRS-161014 Report test new base improvement of Laser cutting VP_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is comparable but needs correction of changed-factor grouping, domains, and outcome evidence before use.
issues: Change domain is wrong; this is tooling/process recipe, not coating or dimension/spec.
Changed factor should be new base plus laser cutting settings, not only condition names.
Bundled test conditions and subgroup key X obscure 2nd-cutting and date grouping.
Measurement outcome is a process-setting summary and cites only a header row.
Evidence omits the key content row and the frame-float caveat row.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new base with increased laser power/cutting recipe settings.
Use Normal as baseline and keep each Test 1-4 row as separate subresult with date/no/type.
Replace subgroup X with meaningful keys such as 2nd cutting status and date.
Limit outcomes to Cutting NG, FS damage, Total NG, and NG rate; remove header-only measurement stats.
Add citations for rows 13, 17-25 and note the frame-float caveat for 2023-09-28 Test 4.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but are incomplete and one outcome is header-only; add content, header, data, and caveat rows.
